content.user_title: Audit Paid Ad Accounts Before Scaling
content.value_statement: Platform ROAS can hide attribution inflation, wasted spend, and measurement gaps. This skill evaluates account evidence through a typed 20-item framework and controlled verdicts.
actual_capabilities: Audits one paid-media account or portfolio under declared business constraints.
Scores 20 criteria across return, offer, audience, and spend efficiency.
Separates platform-reported performance from deduplicated business outcome data.
Checks verified veto conditions for tracking, attribution, claims, policy, and placement safety.
Supports direct-response, prospecting, and incremental-profit profiles.
Returns SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED gates through the configured scorer.
limitations: Requires normalized exports, attribution settings, conversion lag, currency, and business constraints.
Cannot produce a comparable score when required evidence remains unknown.
Does not change bids, budgets, audiences, campaigns, or account settings.
Standalone installs collect observations but cannot calculate final scores or persist audit artifacts.

use_cases.title: Pre-Scale Account Review
use_cases.description: Evaluate measurement quality, marginal return, and operating controls before increasing paid-media spend.

use_cases.title: Attribution Integrity Check
use_cases.description: Compare platform outcomes with deduplicated CRM or commerce records under normalized windows and currency.

use_cases.title: Portfolio Governance Audit
use_cases.description: Document evidence, unknowns, policy concerns, and prioritized fixes across an agency client account.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Account Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid-media account using the [profile] profile. Use [currency], [attribution window], [conversion lag], and [business constraint]. Review the attached exports.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when all required context and standard account exports are available.

prompt_templates.title: Check Measurement Integrity
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit conversion instrumentation and attribution for this account. Reconcile platform conversions with [own-data source], normalize [windows], and identify missing evidence without assuming failure.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reported ROAS may be inflated or duplicated.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Incremental Profit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the incremental-profit profile for [portfolio]. Use [holdout evidence], [margin data], [CAC ceiling], and [observation date]. Label every proxy and estimated input.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the business needs profit-focused evidence beyond platform attribution.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Traceable Governance Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [account] across all 20 criteria. Cite source, date, evidence type, and confidence for each state. Verify vetoes and prioritize fixes with owners and rerun conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced compliance, governance, or portfolio review.

output_examples.input: Direct-response account with complete exports, normalized outcomes, and no verified veto failures.
output: Verdict: SHIP with a final score of 78.
Measurement and attribution evidence are complete.
Prioritize lower-impact efficiency improvements before the next review.

output_examples.input: Account with a verified tracking failure and complete evidence for the remaining criteria.
output: Verdict: FIX with the final score capped at 59.
The own-data truth set confirms a material instrumentation failure.
Repair tracking, validate deduplication, and rerun before scaling.

output_examples.input: Prospecting account without a placement report or complete reconciliation data.
output: Verdict: UNDECIDED because required evidence is unknown.
Provide placement and reconciliation exports before requesting a launch decision.

best_practices: Normalize currency, attribution windows, conversion lag, IDs, and portfolio scope before comparing results.
Use deduplicated business outcomes as the truth set and label estimated or proxy evidence.
Verify every veto with positive evidence and preserve unknown states when evidence is missing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat platform-reported ROAS as causal or sufficient evidence.
Do not convert missing evidence into a pass, failure, or not-applicable state.
Do not change campaign settings or spend during an audit without separate approval.

faq.question: What data does the audit require?
faq.answer: Provide delivery, spend, outcome, attribution, economics, placement, claims, and incrementality evidence when available.

faq.question: Which audit profiles are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports direct-response, prospecting, and incremental-profit profiles.

faq.question: Can the skill change my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates evidence and must not change campaigns, bids, budgets, audiences, or account settings.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: Applicable missing evidence remains unknown and can produce an UNDECIDED result without an overall score.

faq.question: Does a high platform ROAS guarantee a strong result?
faq.answer: No. The audit checks incrementality, attribution inflation, measurement quality, economics, safety, and operating controls.

faq.question: Can a standalone installation calculate the final score?
faq.answer: No. A standalone installation records observations but requires the root deterministic runtime for scoring and persistence.
